name: Trifork Holding AG
summary: Trifork Holding AG offers information technology and various business solutions across a global presence, serving clients in Switzerland, Denmark, the UK, the Netherlands, the United States, and other international regions. The company's operations are divided into two main segments: Trifork and Trifork Labs. The core Trifork division concentrates on the development and management of IT systems and software, extending its activities to include organizing and conducting conferences and training programs, as well as designing workshops. Conversely, the Trifork Labs segment is dedicated to making strategic investments in nascent technology companies. Trifork's specialized domains encompass digital health, financial technology (fintech), intelligent building systems, smart enterprise solutions, cloud infrastructure management, and cybersecurity. Founded in 1996, the firm maintains its headquarters in Schindellegi, Switzerland.
